facts.fact: mTOMADY says DHIS2 is the national health data system used by the Ministry of Public Health in Madagascar.
USAID ACCESS says CommCare integrates its data into Madagascar's national health information management system, which also receives community health volunteers' Monthly Activity Reports.

CommCare, which covers care, surveillance and reporting including COVID-19 and plague tracking, integrates its data into the national health information management system, per USAID ACCESS and Dimagi.

systems.owner: Ministry of Public Health, with USAID ACCESS/MSH/Dimagi
systems.tiers: community health volunteers, health centers, districts

note: Only lists Madagascar's PSRSIS 2023-2027 and PDSS 2025-2030 strategies; names no health management information system.
Document states nothing this study asks for Madagascar.

facts.fact: HISP and the Data.FI project completed a five-month engagement strengthening the Ministry of Public Health's national DHIS2 platform, which hosts the national routine and surveillance systems.
The Countdown 2030 synthesis, presented by health ministry staff, reports national DHIS2 facility data for 2020-2025.
Monthly facility reporting completeness held at 98% in 2024 and 2025, and districts with complete reporting rose from 92% to 94%, per the Countdown 2030 synthesis.

systems.owner: Government of Madagascar with HISP UiO, World Bank financed
